title: Strict quotient reduction towers and their canonical completion data
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subset A$ an ideal. Use the constant coefficient sheaf $\underline A$, the quotient sheaves $S_n=\underline{A/I^{n+1}}$, the completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat A=\lim_n S_n$, and the module, complex, derived-category and scalar-extension constructions of [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data]. Write $q_n:\underline A\to S_n$ for the quotient maps and $S_{n+1}\to S_n$ for their actual quotient transitions; these define the strict ring tower $S_\bullet$. For a coefficient sheaf $\mathcal O$, let $\Delta_{\mathcal O}$ be the constant module-tower functor. Scalar restriction along $\varphi:R\to S$ is $\operatorname{res}_\varphi:\operatorname{Mod}(S)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and $\operatorname{dres}_\varphi$ is its exact induced functor on the standard derived categories. Write $TD(\mathcal O)=D(\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O))$, $TQ_{\mathcal O}$ for its standard localization and $\operatorname{ordinaryLimit}_{\mathcal O}$ for degreewise inverse limit of strict tower complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-inverse-system], [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Choose the universally specified total right derived pair $(R\lim_{\mathcal O},\gamma_{\mathcal O})$ of ordinaryLimit, with $\gamma:\operatorname{ordinaryLimit}_{\mathcal O}Q_{\mathcal O}\to TQ_{\mathcal O}R\lim_{\mathcal O}$, computed by ordinaryLimit on K-injective tower complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. For $b=\mathrm{false}$ put $\mathcal O_b=\underline A$ and $p_{b,n}=q_n$; for $b=\mathrm{true}$ put $\mathcal O_b=\widehat A$ and let $p_{b,n}:\widehat A\to S_n$ be its limit projections. Define $T_b(M)_n=\operatorname{res}_{p_{b,n}}(S_n\otimes_{\mathcal O_b}M)$ with transitions $s\otimes m\mapsto\bar s\otimes m$ and the natural augmentation $\Delta_{\mathcal O_b}M\to T_b(M)$ given by $m\mapsto1\otimes m$. For a complex $P$, reductionComplex is $T_b$ applied degreewise, and ordinaryUnit is the lift of its augmentation to the degreewise inverse limit. A quotient presentation consists of the universal left derived functor $\mathbf LT_b$ with comparison $\beta:Q_{\mathcal O_b}\mathbf LT_b\to T_b^{\mathrm{Cx}}TQ_{\mathcal O_b}$ and a natural transformation $\eta:\operatorname{Id}\to\mathbf LT_bR\lim_{\mathcal O_b}$. The comparison is invertible on flat-term K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and on each such $P$ the defining normalization is $\eta_{Q(P)}\,R\lim(\beta_P)=Q(\operatorname{ordinaryUnit}(P))\,\gamma_{T_b^{\mathrm{Cx}}P}$. Choose this universally specified presentation, determined up to its comparison- and unit-preserving natural isomorphism. Define completion to be $\mathbf LT_bR\lim_{\mathcal O_b}$ and completionUnit to be its displayed $\eta$. These are constructions and their universal comparison data; no Noetherian, reflector, flatness-of-completed-coefficients or equivalence assertion is imposed.
